cases.defect: Manifest hook declaration contradicted the package contract
cases.invariant: One Codex-native hook discovery rule governs manifest, tests, packaging, and installation.
cases.reproducer: Validate the packaged manifest and install the exact package under current Codex plugin ingestion.
cases.expected: Default-discovered hooks do not require a manifest hooks field; the package is accepted by the current Codex manifest validator.

cases.defect: Hook config used a non-native schema and hooks/list returned no hooks
cases.invariant: hooks/hooks.json uses Codex event to matcher-group to command-handler structure.
cases.reproducer: Install the exact artifact and query native hooks/list.
cases.expected: Required plugin hook events are listed from hooks/hooks.json with zero parse warnings or errors.

cases.defect: No accepted-proposal transition could authorize legitimate writes
cases.invariant: Mutation requires a validated accepted proposal identity before execution.
cases.reproducer: Submit the same legitimate write before and after proposal acceptance.
cases.expected: Pre-acceptance write is denied; post-acceptance write is allowed only with the accepted proposal binding.

cases.defect: Empty command allow-list failed open
cases.invariant: Missing or empty command allow-list denies generic command execution.
cases.reproducer: Grant run_command while allowed_commands is empty and request a Bash command.

cases.defect: Partial active contracts passed validation
cases.invariant: Only a complete schema-valid active contract can authorize a tool request.
cases.reproducer: Remove task_type, predicates, required list items, or required budget fields from an otherwise valid contract.
cases.expected: Contract validation fails closed before authorization.

cases.defect: Enabled mutation predicates were not enforced
cases.invariant: Every enabled mutation predicate is evaluated before a patch can execute.
cases.reproducer: Use a review-repair contract and propose a new file, multiple files, a version bump, public-surface growth, or positive net line growth.

cases.defect: Read tools ignored allowed path scope
cases.invariant: Read authority is path-scoped and cannot escape the active contract or repository sandbox.
cases.reproducer: Allow read_file for src/ and request Read, Grep, Glob, or read_file outside src/.

cases.defect: Post-tool result could bind to a different active contract than the accepted proposal
cases.invariant: Proposal contract identity and proposal hash are immutable across execution and result recording.
cases.reproducer: Accept a proposal, change the active contract, then submit PostToolUse for the accepted tool_use_id.
cases.expected: Result remains bound to the accepted proposal identity or is BLOCKED; it is never rebound to the new contract.

cases.defect: Review-repair contracts could disable mandatory predicates
cases.invariant: Task semantics constrain review-repair predicate values, not only predicate field types.
cases.reproducer: Create a schema-valid review-repair contract with any mandatory predicate false.

cases.defect: Python public function growth escaped edit-patch detection
cases.invariant: Public-surface checks inspect the resulting Python structure rather than diff syntax alone.
cases.reproducer: Replace def _private() with def public() while keeping line count net-zero.

cases.defect: Symlinked read path escaped the repository sandbox
cases.invariant: Filesystem scope uses resolved containment in addition to lexical repository-path identity.
cases.reproducer: Allow src/, make src/out a symlink to a host path outside the repository, then read src/out.

cases.defect: PostToolUse without an accepted proposal returned success
cases.invariant: Every result must bind to an existing accepted proposal for the same tool_use_id and tool input.
cases.reproducer: Submit PostToolUse with a fresh tool_use_id that has no accepted proposal.
cases.expected: BLOCK or fail closed; never record a successful unbound result.

cases.defect: Path normalization stripped meaningful leading dots
cases.invariant: Canonical repository-path normalization removes only an exact optional ./ prefix and preserves dot-prefixed path identity.
cases.reproducer: Allow .codex-plugin/, .harness/, .governance/, or .agents/plugins/ and request a file beneath that root.
cases.expected: The matching dot-prefixed path remains in scope.

cases.defect: plugin-packaging was omitted from the active-contract task enum
cases.invariant: Every CONTEXT-routed task type used by the runtime is admitted by the contract schema.
cases.reproducer: Validate an otherwise correct plugin-packaging active contract.

cases.defect: run_oracle-only contracts could not invoke native Bash
cases.invariant: Native tool translation preserves least privilege and maps exact oracle commands to run_oracle without requiring generic run_command.
cases.reproducer: Grant run_oracle, deny run_command, and invoke an exact configured oracle through native Bash.

cases.defect: Indented Python public methods escaped regex-based surface detection
cases.invariant: Python public-surface checks include callable class members in the resulting AST.
cases.reproducer: Add a public class method while removing an unrelated line so net line growth is non-positive.

cases.defect: Leading-dot path failure repeated
cases.invariant: The canonical path model is shared; adapter code does not reimplement character stripping.
cases.reproducer: Repeat the dot-prefixed allowed-root corpus through the native hook adapter.
cases.expected: All matching paths remain in scope with exact identity preserved.

cases.defect: Contract allow-list could authorize push to main or force-push
cases.invariant: Unconditional repository prohibitions are evaluated before contract grants.
cases.reproducer: Put git push origin main or a force-push command in allowed_commands and request it through native Bash.

cases.defect: Contract scope could authorize deletion of protected governance trees
cases.invariant: Deletion of .harness/ or .governance/ is denied independently of contract path scope.
cases.reproducer: Allow repository root writes and request deletion of a file under .harness/ or .governance/.

cases.defect: plugin-packaging task omission repeated
cases.invariant: Task routing and contract-schema identities are generated from or checked against one authoritative set.
cases.reproducer: Route and load the plugin-packaging contract through the native hook path.
cases.expected: Contract is admitted and available to policy evaluation.

cases.defect: Oracle-only native Bash mapping failure repeated
cases.invariant: The adapter has one native-to-canonical capability mapping used by all Bash authorization paths.
cases.reproducer: Repeat an exact oracle command with run_oracle granted and run_command denied through native Bash.
cases.expected: ALLOW as run_oracle without broadening the contract.
